meta.name: api-response-optimization
meta.description: Optimize API response times through caching, compression, and efficient payloads. Improve backend performance and reduce network traffic.

copy.tagline: 通过缓存、压缩和精简载荷来加速 API 响应
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果后端 API 响应慢、需要减少网络流量
copy.tagline_en: Speed up API responses with caching, compression, and efficient payloads
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your backend API responses are slow and you need to reduce network traffic

howto.what: 当您请求优化API响应时，Claude会通过缓存、压缩和精简数据负载来减少传输量，从而提升后端性能和降低网络流量。
howto.when: 当您提到API响应慢、服务器CPU或内存占用高、返回数据过大、性能下降或扩展瓶颈时触发。

say.text: 帮我优化这个API的响应速度。
say.note: Claude会分析并给出缓存、压缩等建议。

say.text: 怎么减少这个接口返回的数据量？
say.note: Claude会指导精简字段和压缩方法。

say.text: 我的API响应太慢，如何改进？
say.note: Claude会检查并推荐优化策略。

howto.what_en: When you ask to optimize API response times, Claude reduces payload size through caching, compression, and efficient data selection to improve backend performance and lower network traffic.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention slow API responses, high CPU/memory usage, large payloads, performance degradation, or scaling bottlenecks.

say_en.text: Help me optimize the response time of this API.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes and suggests caching, compression, etc.

say_en.text: How can I reduce the data size of this endpoint?
say_en.note: Claude guides on field trimming and compression.

say_en.text: My API is slow, how can I improve it?
say_en.note: Claude checks and recommends optimization strategies.
